name: Invalid external product image falls back without crashing
description: Verify a product whose image URL is https://google.com renders the fallback and does not crash either catalog or detail page.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the home page and search for SKU TEST123.
Verify the product named test remains visible and displays an accessible image-unavailable fallback instead of a Next.js image hostname error.
Verify its detail page renders successfully with the image-unavailable fallback, product data, and no application crash or Next.js error overlay.
